summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes shipped obfuscated payload from an ESLint config package
details: The package declares itself an ESLint config for TypeScript/NestJS (main index.js is a small lint-rule re-export) but its package.json preinstall hook runs setup.mjs, which downloads the Bun runtime zip from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases, chmod+x's the extracted `bun` binary in a temp directory, and executes a shipped 727 KB file `math_init.js` under it (execFileSync(bunPath, [math_init.js], {stdio:'inherit'})). Both setup.mjs and math_init.js are heavily obfuscated: setup.mjs uses hex-identifier (_0xNNNN) obfuscation with per-call property-name dictionaries, and math_init.js is a Bun-CJS bundle with a rotating string-array decoder (shift-based rotator, large mixed literal array, alphabet-based decoder). The payload has no relationship to the package's stated ESLint-config purpose and is not documented in the README or CHANGELOG. Installing this version therefore fetches an alternate JS runtime specifically to execute an opaque, obfuscated blob outside the analysis surface of Node-based scanners, giving whoever published this version arbitrary code execution on any machine that runs `npm install`.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
